_help: Edit these values on GitHub to change what you get alerts for. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_pokemon_help: Add as many as you like, e.g. ["rayquaza", "charizard", "umbreon"]. Matches any card of that Pokémon (Rayquaza V, Mega Rayquaza ex, ...).
_alert_when_options: either = FMV or PriceCharting discount is big enough; both = both must be; fmv = only FMV; pricecharting = only PriceCharting
_min_fmv_confidence_help: Courtyard rates its FMV 1-5. Set to 3 to ignore FMV discounts when Courtyard isn't confident.
_graders_help: "PSA" = all PSA grades. "CGC 10" = CGC but only 10s (incl. Pristine). Empty list = all graders.
_min_grade_help: e.g. 9 to only see grade 9 and up. null = any grade.

marktplaats._help: Sealed English Elite Trainer Boxes on Marktplaats, compared with the PriceCharting sealed price (converted to euros).
marktplaats._include_bids_help: true = also alert on 'Bieden vanaf' ads that state a minimum bid
